condition: When model validators are defined on both a base class and a subclass, the subclass validators run before the parent's, and a subclass 'after' validator runs outside the base class's 'wrap' validator. This is the reverse of V1, where parent validators ran first.
workaround: Don't rely on parent validators running first. Put any ordering-dependent logic in one validator, or have the subclass call the parent's logic explicitly.
